title: SvgFeDistantLight
responsibility: Renders the native feDistantLight element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeDistantLight.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet rendered inside the feDistantLight element with {@render children()} only when it is truthy. When it is omitted (undefined), the element renders with no child content, and any value passed must be a Snippet, since the code calls it as a function.

outputs.name: SvgFeDistantLight
outputs.description: The rendered native feDistantLight element in the svg namespace, with every prop other than children passed through the {...attributes} spread and the children snippet rendered inside it. The component adds no wrapper element around it and does not validate attribute names or values.
